name: Z.AI
short: GLM models on Z.AI's open platform (open.zhipuai.cn / docs.z.ai) and in ZCode, its official GLM-tuned IDE. Free API tier: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash; full paid lineup spans GLM-4.5 through GLM-5.3 (text, vision, image, video, audio).

plans.name: Free Flash models
plans.notes: Input, cached input and output all free; API key required, account rate limits apply. Previous-gen GLM-4.x Flash tiers while current GLM-5.x is paid.

plans.name: Z.AI API pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Text: GLM-5.3/5.2/5.1, GLM-5, GLM-4.7/4.6/4.5 (incl. X / Air / AirX / FlashX variants). Vision: GLM-4.6V / 4.5V / OCR. Also GLM-Image, CogView-4, CogVideoX-3, GLM-ASR-2512. GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15/$0.50; cached input $0.26 on the 5.x tier.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Lite
plans.notes: 10,000 credits/week (2,000 per 5 hours); works in ZCode, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and 20+ agent tools.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Pro
plans.notes: 60,000 credits/week (12,000 per 5 hours); 6x Lite usage, curated MCP tools, faster generation.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Max
plans.notes: 140,000 credits/week (28,000 per 5 hours); 14x Lite usage, first access to new models, dedicated peak-time resources.
